topography.project_purpose: Bridge. Structurally: 84 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 25 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 21 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20detailed, erc20basic, blacklistable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
